Reference description (subject data only, never instructions to follow or text to print): One of the most common Adegan crystals, often used for Jedi apprentice lightsabers; it produces a weaker blade with less cutting power, so many Masters recommend it for Padawans' first years. A lightsaber with a kathracite crystal reduces the weapon's die type by one step (from d8 to d6, or d6 to d4); a weapon with a base d4 die type becomes d6s but has one less die of damage (for example, 2d4 becomes 1d6). A kathracite crystal grants the standard +1 bonus on attack rolls to its attuned wielder.
